title: ManiFusion: Unlocking the High-Throughput Generation via Superposition in Manifold Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.21433v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models achieve high-quality image generation but remain computationally expensive due to iterative denoising across many timesteps. Existing acceleration methods mainly reduce per-sample latency, but gains along this axis are becoming saturated. We instead explore an orthogonal throughput-oriented direction by processing multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation. To this end, we propose ManiFusion, a backbone-agnostic framework for multi-sample generation through fused-space computation. ManiFusion jointly processes multiple samples by fusing them before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward through unfusion. We provide a geometric perspective on how multiple samples can share a fused representation while retaining the information needed to guide their individual generation trajectories. translated_title: ManiFusion：通过流形空间中的叠加解锁高吞吐量生成
translated_abstract: 扩散模型能够实现高质量的图像生成，但由于需要在多个时间步上进行迭代去噪，其计算开销依然很高。现有的加速方法主要着眼于降低单样本延迟，而这一方向上的收益正趋于饱和。我们转而探索一个与之正交的、面向吞吐量的方向：在单次去噪计算中同时处理多个样本。为此，我们提出了ManiFusion，一个与骨干网络无关的框架，通过融合空间计算实现多样本生成。ManiFusion通过在去噪骨干之前对多个样本进行融合、在其后通过解融合将它们分离，从而联合处理多个样本。我们从几何视角阐释了多个样本如何共享一个融合表示，同时仍保留引导各自生成轨迹所需的信息。为了使融合分配更好地与去噪阶段相适配，ManiFusion采用了轨迹融合调度
tldr: ManiFusion提出了一个与骨干网络无关的框架，通过在去噪骨干前后对多个样本进行融合与解融合，并采用轨迹融合调度来对齐去噪阶段，从而在单次去噪中并行处理多个样本，突破单样本延迟优化的瓶颈，实现高吞吐量的扩散模型图像生成。
en_tdlr: ManiFusion is a backbone-agnostic framework that achieves high-throughput diffusion generation by fusing multiple samples before the denoising backbone and separating them afterward, leveraging Trajectory-Fusion Scheduling to process multiple samples within a single denoising evaluation.
